title: EventBus callback same-owner different-callback registration recovery contract

contract.same_owner_registration_isolation: A callback cannot register a different callback for an already registered plugin owner and event
contract.duplicate_owner_prevention: An existing plugin owner remains represented by exactly one listener entry per event
contract.callback_preservation: A conflicting registration attempt does not replace the original callback
contract.current_cycle_delivery_once: The original listener receives the active broadcast exactly once
contract.conflicting_callback_isolation: A rejected conflicting callback receives no broadcast
contract.post_conflict_delivery_once: Subsequent broadcasts continue delivering exactly once per registered listener
contract.registry_integrity: The listener registry remains structurally valid after conflicting callback registration
contract.unique_owner_integrity: Each plugin owner has at most one listener entry for an event
contract.source_metadata: Delivered events preserve the plugin_id supplied to emit() as source metadata
contract.emit_continuity: EventBus.emit() remains successful before and after conflicting registration
contract.permission_enforcement: Registration and emit operations require the events permission
